get.summary: Get the signed-in user's home feed

200.description: Busy rooms, the next movie night and activity (up to eight latest ratings, approved reviews, public list updates, shared watchlist additions and watches from active followed members). Profile and section privacy are checked on every request. Each activity has a source-prefixed string id, kind, user, nullable tmdb_id, media_type and created_at. Ratings/reviews include nullable rating, nullable excerpt and has_spoilers; spoiler text and hidden ratings are omitted. List activity includes list {id, title}.

The current user's profile and preferences. `has_password` is false while an account made by Google, GitHub or Discord sign-in has not chosen its own password yet. `pending_email` is the address waiting for its confirmation link (PUT /api/me/email), or null.

patch.description: Any of `name`, `username`, `location`, `bio` and `profile_visibility`. `email` is accepted only when it equals the current address (forms send the whole profile); a different one is rejected with 422, because changing it goes through PUT /api/me/email.

422.description: Validation failed, or `email` differs from the current address.

patch.description: Any of `favorite_genres`, `privacy`, `integrations` and `notifications`; each group only changes the switches sent. `notifications` has one switch per notification type (`follow`, `follow_accepted`, `room_invite`, `room_joined`, `room_deleted`, `new_messages`, `mention`, `night_invite`, `night_rsvp`, `night_vote`, `night_update`, `review_helpful`), all on by default; a switched-off type is never sent. Follow requests have no switch: they always arrive.

post.description: Lets the member who asked follow your followers-only or private profile. Their request turns into a `follow` notification ("started following you") and they get `follow_accepted`.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Username of the member who asked.

200.description: Request accepted; they now follow you.

404.description: No such user, or no pending request from them.

delete.description: Removes the pending request (dismissing the `follow_request` notification does the same). Nothing happens when there is none.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Username of the member who asked.

current_password.description: Required when GET /api/me has `has_password: true`; omitted when a social sign-up sets its first password.

422.description: Validation failed, or the current password is missing or wrong.

put.summary: Ask to change the sign-in email
put.description: Stores the address as `pending_email` and mails a signed confirmation link to it (valid 60 minutes); `user.email` and `email_verified_at` do not change until that link is opened. The current address gets a notice with the new one partly hidden. A new request replaces an earlier pending address, whose link then stops working. Rate limited to 3 per minute and 10 per hour per account (shared with resend).

email.description: Must differ from the current address and not belong to another account.

current_password.description: Required when GET /api/me has `has_password: true`; omitted by accounts made by social sign-in that never chose a password.

200.description: The account (same shape as GET /api/me) with `pending_email` set.

422.description: Validation failed (invalid, unchanged or taken email), or the current password is missing or wrong (on `current_password`).

delete.description: Clears `pending_email`, so links already sent stop working. Nothing happens when there is none.

post.summary: Resend the email change confirmation link
post.description: Mails a fresh 60-minute link to `pending_email`. Shares the rate limit of PUT /api/me/email.

200.description: Link sent; the account is returned.

422.description: There is no pending email change.

get.summary: Confirm a new email address (signed link)
get.description: Opened from the email sent by PUT /api/me/email; no login is required. A valid link makes `pending_email` the sign-in email, marks it verified, revokes every refresh token of the account (all devices sign in again once their access token expires) and tells the previous address, then redirects to FRONTEND_URL/edit-profile?email_change=success. Replaced, cancelled, tampered or unknown links redirect with `invalid`, correctly signed expired ones with `expired`, and `taken` when another account started using the address meanwhile (the pending change is then dropped). Rate limited to 20 requests per minute per IP.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: SHA-1 of the pending email address.

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Unix timestamp at which the link expires (part of the signed URL).

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: URL signature generated by the server.

302.description: Redirect to FRONTEND_URL/edit-profile with email_change=success, invalid, expired or taken.

200.description: Matching user profiles, each with the signed-in user's follow state: `is_following`, `is_requested` (a follow request waiting for their answer) and `follows_you`.
Profile, subject to the owner's privacy settings, with `is_following`, `is_requested` (your follow request is waiting for their answer) and `follows_you`.

get.summary: List users followed by a user

post.description: A public profile is followed at once and gets a `follow` notification. A followers-only or private profile gets a follow request instead (`following: false, requested: true`) until its owner accepts or declines it; asking again changes nothing.

delete.description: Also withdraws a pending follow request.

get.description: `mine`: your lists. `public`: other members' public lists, except those of followers-only and private profiles you don't follow. `following`: public lists of the people you follow.

The saved review with automatic sentiment and Groq moderation_labels (offensive language, spoiler, spam; empty for clean reviews, null if classification was unavailable). Clean reviews publish immediately; offensive language, spoilers, spam, self-tagged spoilers, or classification failures wait for admin approval. Edits are classified again.
